decisions.summary: One margin seated once; the ladder only past a margin seating no house; partial seating refused; rescue, withheld re-seat, early stop, 12:1 refusal removed
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-004-FR-006, SC-003a; the GM: 'get rid of this pattern completely'.

decisions.summary: No radius test; main's GROW_LEVELS (8/12/16), then 16 directions one half-ring further each level only when they run dry, until a level queues no seat on the canvas; the single every-direction level withdrawn
decisions.why: FR-002 ('keep growing outward ... while households are left and free ground remains'); FR-003a's main breadth held, the widening beginning only where main stopped and restarted. The GM: 'just keep placing houses outside of the boundary'. The stale one-level sentence is gone; growth.grow_level matches.

decisions.summary: FIELD_REACH_FT and within_field_reach deleted; rasters over boundary.seating_window, answers past it decided exactly or counted open; free_seats and site_boundary.window the canvas; ways/law.py untouched
decisions.why: FR-003 as amended and verified, SC-002; the GM: 'get rid of these 700 feet measurement completely'. The window bounds cost, never where a house may stand.

decisions.summary: Main's levels; heap keyed by TIE_RING_FT ring of distance from the margin's seat center, field distance breaking ties within a ring; first amendment withdrawn
decisions.why: FR-003a, SC-002a; the GM: 'all else being equal, try this first' and 'the tie-break thing for the real speedup'.

decisions.summary: recheck_passages keeps only its in-place ending, after the gap pass; relay removed
Occasions: farmhouse placement on the nucleated pool maps; village lane
decisions.why: Review process for what the change moves.

decisions.summary: grow_gap = MIN_WEB_GAP + 2 ft parting = 20 ft; tight seat exempt from its one neighbor only
decisions.why: FR-011 (pairwise), SC-007; the GM: 'a slightly higher minimum distance from your neighbors'.

decisions.summary: Lane-ground raster: taken cells grown by a cell plus wood seats, homesteads unpainted (FR-011 guarantees their gap), flooded from exit strip, field corridor and the window's edge; what it misses (past-window yards, sub-lane pockets against paddy/water/edge) ends as a counted pinch; one predicate admits ordinary and refuses tight seats
decisions.why: The check does not prove every admitted yard connected. Implied by the GM's own words: 'gap rule plus some kind of cheap check' and 'I'm not concerned about the other lane-blocking map features because ... it's okay for people to cut through neighbors' yards in a pinch'. With homesteads a threading gap apart, the misses are exactly those features; each is counted (meta.pinch_passages), and FR-012 now carries the same statement, verified FAITHFUL. The plan states it rather than 'as today', as asked.

decisions.summary: No per-seat corridor search, judgment or reservation; exit strip and field corridor kept; a passage household's walk still barred; access_corridor kept for the post-pass recheck
decisions.why: The walk bar is not a search ('drop the search entirely'); without it a later house could stand on the tight seat FR-011/FR-013 keep. The only corridor calls left run after the last house stands (SC-008).

decisions.summary: gap_ways.py at the seating's end: one lane raster, one flood from the way out costed to the gaps' middle, per-house local exits (6), traced to the way out or a T within 25 ft, taut, admitted by the lane law, reserved and recorded
decisions.why: FR-014 clause by clause; the GM: 'I still want A for how it shapes the map'.

decisions.summary: A household no admitted way reaches recorded reached across the nearest household with a laid way (kind pinch), counted in meta.pinch_passages
decisions.why: FR-014's fallback; the GM's 'cut through neighbors' yards in a pinch' carries no adjoining condition; counted so a miss is visible (SC-009).
